title: The Goalkeeper — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 98bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The goalkeeper is the only player allowed to use their hands
And for ninety minutes mostly they don't need to
Mostly they stand and watch eleven other people have all the feelings

[Verse 2 — Español]
El portero es un especialista en la espera [The goalkeeper is a specialist in waiting]
En la alerta particular de alguien [In the particular alertness of someone]
Que puede ser necesitado urgentemente en cualquier momento [Who might be needed urgently at any moment]
O en absoluto [Or not at all]
Pero debe actuar como si ambos fueran igualmente probables [But must act as if both are equally likely]

[Chorus — English]
The goalkeeper says — I am ready
The goalkeeper says — I have been ready since the whistle
The goalkeeper says — the ball will come here eventually
And when it does — I will have the only opinion that matters

[Bridge — Français]
Chas disait — le travail du gardien c'est la concentration sans événement [Chas said — the goalkeeper's job is concentration without event]
La plupart des gens peuvent se concentrer quand les choses se passent [Most people can concentrate when things are happening]
Le gardien se concentre en l'absence de choses qui se passent [The goalkeeper concentrates through the absence of things happening]
C'est la compétence la plus difficile [That is the harder skill]
Et personne n'en parle à la mi-temps [And nobody talks about it at half time]

[Verse 3 — English]
When the goalkeeper makes the save the crowd erupts
The goalkeeper understands the silence
The goalkeeper chose this

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The goalkeeper
El portero [The goalkeeper]
Le gardien [The goalkeeper]
That's my boy
